Imaad Abbasi is a Pakistani-American from the suburbs of Chicago, Illinois. His parents came to the US at a young age and taught him about immigration and culture. He increasingly became invested in working class issues, primarily labor rights and the failures that they had endured. He is currently at GW studying Economics and Political Science with a Public Policy focus, minoring in Data Science. He likes to play guitar, learn Spanish, and write about politics in his free time.
